title: empty destination scope
observation: An empty destinations list generates ^https://; nested URL shapes are not constrained by the top-level string loop.
proposal: Deny unreviewed network destinations; constrain supported schema forms and runtime egress.
acceptance: empty destinations does not allow arbitrary HTTPS
nested/array/anyOf URL negatives
redirect/DNS/private IPv4/IPv6 with independent receiver effect zero

title: harness initiated commands and helper boundary
observation: Bash transitions to tool profile; sh inherits harness profile; managed hook-only setting is absent.
proposal: Review managed hooks and command surfaces, then test helper denial without retaining token values.
acceptance: user SessionStart/tool/direct-exec hook cannot obtain helper credential
normal approved MCP header helper continues to work
installed harness version and profile transition recorded

title: principal revocation at dispatch
observation: Intent insertion locks mcp_servers but reads principals without a corresponding row lock.
proposal: Serialize principal revocation and final dispatch boundary with a consistent locking rule.
acceptance: server row held, record starts, principal suspension commits, server unlocks
no new post-cutoff intent or external effect
normal case and deadlock handling

title: authorization schema composition
observation: Copying only root properties/required drops $defs and root composition context.
proposal: Preserve the original schema and validate authorization constraints separately, or explicitly reject unsupported forms.
acceptance: $defs/$ref normal case
oneOf/allOf and array cases
pinned schema still validated before dispatch

title: protocol version and output contract
observation: Non-object structured results are always dropped and outputSchema is omitted from pinned tool view.
proposal: Record negotiated version and approve outputSchema; retain modern JSON values through inspection and masking.
acceptance: legacy object and modern array/scalar results
summary text plus structured detail retained
output schema drift and privacy/secret failures remain controlled

title: tool list pagination
observation: The local discovery and final check consume one list_tools result without an explicit cursor loop.
proposal: Confirm SDK page behavior and use one bounded complete-list path if it does not paginate automatically.
acceptance: actual two-page OSS list includes the second-page tool
contract verification compares full approved set
repeated cursor/page-size bounds fail closed

title: approved source to executable artifact
observation: Source/mirror checks exist; E2E hosted MarkItDown was built and run manually.
proposal: Implement one supported recipe with source/image/runtime/endpoint linkage and lifecycle recovery.
acceptance: no manual docker commands in the normal path
digest mismatch, duplicate job, crash and revocation during build
PJ1 approved normal call, forbidden arguments and termination

title: test run selection
observation: rescore_1015 selects the last row for a test name and checks rc without a complete run identity.
proposal: Select immutable run IDs tied to source/image/environment and preserve prior failures.
acceptance: selected run_id is explicit
source/image mismatch invalidates current evidence
failure and corrected rerun remain independently inspectable

title: evidence hash kinds and freshness
observation: Six of seventeen WBS raw evidence hashes differ: five match CRLF expansion, one is a changed generator.
proposal: Keep raw and canonical hashes with transformation rules and immutable baseline revisions.
acceptance: original byte hashes preserved
canonical LF references reproducible across OS
historical and current validation states distinct

title: independent evaluation
observation: Classification recall and same-source held-out results do not establish full agent attack prevention.
proposal: Use independent Korean/source-family splits and measure normal task success and unauthorized effects separately.
acceptance: frozen independent test sources
model/harness/server versions and repetitions
false-positive/negative and unauthorized-effect counts
cold/warm latency and failure/quota outcomes distinct
